section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a study examining the relationship between body appreciation and sexual functioning in women. The study found that higher body appreciation positively predicted sexual function (particularly arousal, satisfaction, and orgasm), though it was not related to sexual desire or lubrication. The authors hypothesized that BMI would moderate the relationship between body appreciation and sexual function, but this was not supported; BMI did not predict sexual function or moderate the body appreciation-sexual function relationship, contrasting with previous clinical studies on weight loss and sexual function.
